title: I built a stock research tool to find opportunities the crowd is overlooking
author: chillguy89_vn
selftext:
I've been investing in stocks for decade. And one thing bothered me is most of retail investors lack of information, tools, always chasing hype. So they often buy peak, panic sell, repeat and eventually lose faith in the market.

In contrast, institutions have better data, better tools and way more money to play the game. 

The small investors only have one advantage: we small, so we can in or out and no one cares, even the market. That's why I built Quantiverse.ai. 

The idea is simple: find good stocks that money has moved away from, crowd has ignored, then watch for signs capital is coming back and get in. Less risk, quicker return, easy to execute.

Instead of digging through thousands of tickers, the system gives me a short list every day of stocks worth a closer look. No magic signals. Just trying to find good businesses before they become crowded again.

Still very much a work in progress both algorithm and tools.

Would love to hear some feedback from people here - what would make a stock research tool actually useful enough for you to keep coming back to it?
